senses.gloss: able to be used in many different ways or for many purposes

definition_translations.zh_TW: 可用於多種方式或多種用途的

definition_translations.ko_KR: 여러 방식이나 여러 목적에 사용할 수 있는

senses.gloss: able to do many different tasks or activities well
senses.example: The company needs versatile employees who can support several departments.

translations.th_TH: อเนกประสงค์

example_translations.zh_TW: 公司需要能支援多個部門的多才多藝員工。

example_translations.ko_KR: 그 회사는 여러 부서를 지원할 수 있는 다재다능한 직원들이 필요합니다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Công ty cần những nhân viên đa năng có thể hỗ trợ nhiều phòng ban.
example_translations.th_TH: บริษัทต้องการพนักงานที่มีความสามารถหลากหลายและช่วยสนับสนุนได้หลายแผนก

definition_translations.ko_KR: 여러 다양한 업무나 활동을 잘할 수 있는
definition_translations.vi_VN: có thể làm tốt nhiều nhiệm vụ hoặc hoạt động khác nhau
